The structure of Li8Cr4Ru4O24 (reduced formula Li2CrRuO6) is cubic, with space group Fm-3m (No. 225) and 40 atoms in the unit cell across four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Cr and Ru each in octahedral environments with six O neighbors, while Li shows a close-packed-like local arrangement with twelve O neighbors. O centers coordinate to one Cr and one Ru. Validated polyhedron contacts include corner-sharing between Cr and Ru octahedra, with additional face-sharing between Cr octahedra and Li 12-vertex polyhedra.
